dc:title: Talenta Sample Dataset: Calculated Public-Transport Delays at 10 Stops
dc:description: Sample of the prepared GTFS delay dataset of the mFUND project Talenta (FKZ 01F2235A-C). Derived from real static and real-time GTFS data; delay = actual minus scheduled arrival time.

columns.name: Origin
columns.dc:description: Name of the previous stop the vehicle came from

columns.name: Destination
columns.dc:description: Name of the stop the vehicle arrived at (GTFS stop_name)

columns.name: stop_sequence
columns.dc:description: GTFS stop_sequence of the arrival stop within the trip

columns.name: route_id
columns.dc:description: GTFS route_id of the source feed (feed-internal)

columns.name: slot_00_03
columns.dc:description: 1 if the scheduled time falls between 00:00 and 03:00

columns.name: slot_03_06
columns.dc:description: 1 if the scheduled time falls between 03:00 and 06:00

columns.name: slot_06_09
columns.dc:description: 1 if the scheduled time falls between 06:00 and 09:00

columns.name: slot_09_12
columns.dc:description: 1 if the scheduled time falls between 09:00 and 12:00

columns.name: slot_12_15
columns.dc:description: 1 if the scheduled time falls between 12:00 and 15:00

columns.name: slot_15_18
columns.dc:description: 1 if the scheduled time falls between 15:00 and 18:00

columns.name: slot_18_21
columns.dc:description: 1 if the scheduled time falls between 18:00 and 21:00

columns.name: slot_21_24
columns.dc:description: 1 if the scheduled time falls between 21:00 and 24:00

columns.name: delay
columns.dc:description: Actual minus scheduled arrival time; empty if not available. Unit: minutes (inferred from the value distribution)
